channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Dwindling cash and soaring memory costs: Tech's AI buildout has ballooning price tag
item.description: Amazon, Alphabet and Tesla all reported negative cash flow in the latest quarter, while Meta's cash generation plummeted by 91%.

item.title: How Leopold Aschenbrenner built a $45 billion AI hedge fund — and lost most of it in days
item.description: Leopold Aschenbrenner, a former OpenAI researcher-turned-hedge fund manager, saw a dramatic decline this week in his AI-focused fund, Situational Awareness.

item.title: Fed officials who voted to hike rates say action is needed now against inflation
item.description: Kashkari and Hammack joined Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan in dissenting against holding the Fed's key overnight borrowing rate steady.

item.title: Democrats demand information on Trump and Lutnick families' ties to critical mineral deals
item.description: The senators asked the Departments of Commerce, Defense, Energy, Interior and the Export-Import Bank to preserve all records related to those deals.

item.title: Exxon and Chevron profits surge on rising oil prices due to Iran war
item.description: ExxonMobil and Chevron on Friday reported second-quarter profits that surged on rising oil prices due to the Iran war.

item.title: GM to launch its own in-vehicle AI system later this year
item.description: General Motors plans to launch a proprietary in-vehicle artificial intelligence system that's better tailored for its customers later this year.

item.title: Amazon is surging after earnings. How to trade the hyperscaler for more upside while defining risk
item.description: Jeff Kilburg breaks down how he's trading AMZN.

item.title: U.S. lawmakers request information from DoorDash on use of Chinese AI models
item.description: The food delivery company is the latest to be asked to share details of AI use by a House Committee joint investigation.

item.title: New York sues Kalshi, says prediction market is running 'illegal gambling operation'
item.description: It comes after a federal judge earlier this month denied Kalshi's attempts to intervene against the state's Gaming Commission.

item.title: Novo Nordisk shares dive after heart medicine fails trial, dealing another blow to its pipeline
item.description: The experimental medicine ziltivekimab didn't translate into a statistically meaningful reduction in major cardiovascular adverse events, Novo said Friday.

item.title: Anthropic says its Claude models 'gained unauthorized access' to other organizations' systems
item.description: Anthropic said it discovered three instances where its Claude AI models accessed the internet during an evaluation and accessed outside systems.

item.title: More consumer companies are staying private for longer, avoiding the IPO road
item.description: With the rise of secondary markets and a stronger liquidity environment, more companies are choosing to stay private for longer, according to experts.

item.title: Leonardo expects more deals as Europe ramps up defense spending
item.description: Leonardo is eyeing further M&A as it races to expand capabilities and meet surging defense demand after raising its 2026 outlook.

item.title: Iran targets strategic U.S. assets in Kuwait, Bahrain after Egypt drone attack
item.description: Iran's army said it launched attacks on strategic U.S. assets and military bases in Kuwait and Bahrain.

item.title: Momentum stocks score one of their best days in history after the 'Leopold liquidation'
item.description: Talk about a snap-back move.

item.title: Oil prices rise after Iran says it attacked two tankers transiting Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Commonwealth Bank of Australia said in a note on Friday that stronger oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz had eased market concerns after U.S.-Iran strikes earlier this week.

item.title: Hamas says Trump's Gaza 'disarmament' claim depends on Israel honoring commitments
item.description: Hamas says it will only disarm after Israel meets previous ceasefire commitments, despite President Donald Trump's announcement of a breakthrough U.S.-brokered agreement.

item.title: EV prices aren't following the 'law of used cars,' analyst says — what it means for buyers and sellers
item.description: The prices for used electric vehicles have risen this year, which is unusual, experts said. Affordability and high gas prices help explain why, they said.

item.title: Amazon got $600 million in Trump tariff refunds and will pass return along to some customers
item.description: The company previously hadn't disclosed whether it would recoup tariff costs after the Supreme Court ruled many of President Donald Trump's levies were illegal.

item.title: 34-year-old CEO bet on AI video 5 years before ChatGPT—convincing Mark Cuban to invest was the easy part
item.description: Victor Riparbelli launched Synthesia in 2017 to help people 'make a Hollywood film from a laptop.' After four years of middling results, he made a major shift.

item.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Friday
item.description: Nasdaq futures are up, driven by an excellent quarter for Amazon.

item.title: CNBC Select’s weekly mortgage rate snapshot: See your options today
item.description: Here are the mortgage rates are for the week ending July 30, according to Freddie Mac.

item.title: New Medicaid work rules could cause patients to lose coverage, rare disease advocates warn
item.description: New Medicaid work requirements could put rare disease patients’ coverage at risk. NORD CEO Pamela Gavin explains how families can prepare.

item.title: Reddit CEO says Google's AI Overviews can't replace '10 blue links' for referral traffic
item.description: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman said his company has to find ways to work around changes at Google, which is delivering less traffic than in the past.

item.title: A portfolio manager says investors are looking overseas as Magnificent Seven worries grow. Here are the stocks and sectors he favors
item.description: Janus Henderson’s Julian McManus says investors are looking overseas as Magnificent Seven concentration worries revive diversification.

item.title: 'The Odyssey' extends stay in 70 mm Imax theaters as shows sell out weeks in advance
item.description: Universal and Imax have extended the availability of 70 mm screenings of Christopher Nolan's retelling of Homer's epic into mid-September.

item.title: IBM CEO says quantum computing will have a 'measurable impact' on earnings by 2028 or 2029
item.description: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna said the company's investments in quantum computing should begin to have "a measurable impact" on revenue and earnings by 2028 or 2029.

item.title: Deadly storms and a global supply squeeze are sending copper prices soaring
item.description: Deadly storms in Chile have disrupted mining operations, further straining supply and potentially driving prices higher, strategists say.

item.title: The Tech Download: Anduril CEO Brian Schimpf talks AI in warfare and manufacturing push
item.description: CNBC's Arjun Kharpal sits down on The Tech Download podcast with the defense company chief.

item.title: Microsoft's Xbox chief lays out plan to pass rivals on margin by 2030 in memo to employees
item.description: Microsoft's gaming unit wants to invest in its Minecraft franchise and expand through partnerships, including in China.
